selection: For each objective choose the model and baseline/optimized route with highest mean-source AP on the complete primary development set; catalog order, baseline before optimized break ties. No heldout labels or scores choose this route.
calibration: Primary full-development raw zero, maximumF1, pooled/every-source 5% FPR; XRF source development only calibrates secondary source thresholds.
inference: Reuse the original, unchanged per-model margins; no additional GPU inference or weight training.
qualification: An additional retrospective development-only comparison declared after initial heldout forwards began. It is not part of the original pre-forward ensemble protocol and is not a new independent acceptance test.
